title: Norwegian Lamb Hash
description: A hearty and flavorful dish featuring lamb, potatoes, and vegetables, perfect for a cold winter's day.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt and pepper.
Heat the Norwegian oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the lamb until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the lamb to a baking dish and set aside.
Add the sliced onion, bell pepper, and carrots to the skillet. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the hash browns to the skillet and cook until they are golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the vegetable mixture to the baking dish with the lamb.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Serve the Norwegian lamb hash hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
